title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Buy-and-Hold and Dividend Investing

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of reinvesting dividends in a buy‑and‑hold strategy?
options: It increases the number of shares owned without additional cash.
It ensures dividends will rise each year.
questions.explanation: Reinvesting dividends uses the cash payout to buy more shares, growing your holdings over time.

questions.text: True or false: A company's ability to pay dividends depends on its having steady earnings and manageable debt.
questions.explanation: The narration links steady earnings and manageable debt to the likelihood of continued dividend payments.
